title: dev : aaps crash after install
symptom: After installing the APK from the dev branch, clicking on the open button causes AAPS to crash systematically.
cause: The problem seems to be in OpenHuman module in OHCounterDelegate.kt (line 12) where sp.getLong("openhumans_counter", 1) is called, possibly causing a crash in the Android library.
fix: A commit (dc90c6b140e9df77b5739ba1ccd32a951cc83bae) was made to resolve the crash, and the user confirmed the problem is fixed.
